title: Extending the MM-AR Metamodeling Platform with Process Mining Capabilities
abstract: arXiv:2611.05176v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Process mining derives process models from event data recorded by information systems, but its results are usually presented as two-dimensional visualizations that are separate from the environments in which enterprise models are created and maintained. Metamodeling platforms for extended reality (XR), such as MM-AR, allow users to define modeling languages and to display models in 2D and 3D, but they do not provide access to event data or mining algorithms so far. translated_title: 为MM-AR元建模平台扩展过程挖掘能力
translated_abstract: 过程挖掘能够从信息系统记录的事件数据中推导出过程模型，但其结果通常以二维可视化的形式呈现，与企业模型创建和维护的环境相互分离。面向扩展现实（XR）的元建模平台（如MM-AR）允许用户定义建模语言并以二维和三维方式展示模型，但迄今为止尚不支持访问事件数据或挖掘算法。因此，本文提出了首个概念验证方案，展示如何通过一个基于开源PM4Py过程挖掘库的独立Python服务，在不修改平台核心的情况下，为基于XR的元建模平台扩展过程发现能力。我们使用三种常见的发现算法，基于CSV或XES格式的事件日志获取Petri网和BPMN模型，演示了该方法，并利用四个公开事件日志进行了技术评估。
tldr: 本文首次提出概念验证方案，通过基于PM4Py的独立Python服务，在不修改平台核心的前提下，为XR元建模平台MM-AR扩展了过程发现能力，使从事件日志中挖掘出的Petri网和BPMN模型能够直接在沉浸式2D/3D建模环境中展示。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a first proof-of-concept for extending the XR-based MM-AR metamodeling platform with process discovery capabilities, without changing the platform core, through a standalone Python service based on the open-source PM4Py library, enabling mined Petri net and BPMN models from event logs to be visualized directly within immersive 2D/3D modeling environments.
